tools.name: start_memostem
tools.description: Start MemoStem when no topic is named. Show a localized welcome App before login, or the connected owner's topic labels and empty-state guidance. Pass the conversation language as locale when known. No drafts are created.

tools.name: connect_memostem
tools.description: Connect or grant knowledge read permission through the host OAuth flow, then show a page of the authenticated owner's topic labels. Never creates knowledge.

tools.name: validate_knowledge_bundle
tools.description: Validate exactly one user-selected, independently teachable general-knowledge bundle without an account and without saving it. tools.name: save_guest_knowledge_bundles
tools.description: Store one to 10 specifically selected, independently teachable general-knowledge bundles from the current conversation in a private temporary MemoStem guest shelf. Call only after a direct request or clear acceptance of a specific proposal. Reuse workspace_token to continue the same shelf, but never

tools.name: refresh_guest_knowledge_shelf_link
tools.description: Issue a new short-lived, one-time mobile or desktop web link for the existing guest shelf. Use only when the person asks to open or recover that shelf. Pass the private workspace_token as a tool argument; never show or put it in a URL. This adds no card and makes the previous view link invalid.

tools.name: claim_guest_knowledge_workspace
tools.description: Transfer the temporary guest shelf identified by workspace_token to the authenticated MemoStem owner as private pending drafts. Call only after the person explicitly agrees to connect or after the guest shelf reports account_required. This tool never approves or publishes cards.

tools.name: preview_knowledge_bundle
tools.description: Return a transient preview of exactly one user-selected, independently teachable general-knowledge bundle without an account and without saving it. tools.name: check_memostem_connection
tools.description: Verify the MemoStem connection and report only the currently granted knowledge permissions. Without an account it reports status guest with no permissions, and the temporary guest shelf stays available. This test does not read or write knowledge.

tools.name: create_card_drafts

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: refresh_guest_knowledge_shelf_link · Private data: save_guest_knowledge_bundles, refresh_guest_knowledge_shelf_link, claim_guest_knowledge_workspace · Public sink: create_card_drafts · Destructive: create_card_drafts, create_knowledge_bundle_drafts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: refresh_guest_knowledge_shelf_link · Private data: save_guest_knowledge_bundles, refresh_guest_knowledge_shelf_link, claim_guest_knowledge_workspace · Public sink: create_card_drafts · Destructive: create_card_drafts, create_knowledge_bundle_drafts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
